home.headline: Know your air.
home.subheadline: Real-time air quality for every Chicago neighborhood — plain language, no jargon.

status.good: The air in {neighborhood} is clean today.
status.moderate: Air quality is acceptable in {neighborhood}, but sensitive groups should take care.
status.usg: Sensitive groups in {neighborhood} may experience health effects. Limit time outdoors.
status.unhealthy: Everyone in {neighborhood} may experience health effects. Avoid prolonged outdoor activity.
status.veryUnhealthy: Health alert for {neighborhood}: avoid outdoor activity.
status.noData: No current air quality reading available for this area.

pollutants.heading: What's In Your Air
pollutants.pm25Desc: Tiny particles from vehicles, industrial sites, and fires that reach deep into your lungs. Can worsen asthma and heart conditions.
pollutants.ozoneDesc: Forms when sunlight reacts with exhaust from cars and factories. Makes breathing harder, especially for children and older adults.
pollutants.pm10Desc: Larger dust and particles that irritate your nose, throat, and lungs.
pollutants.no2Desc: Comes mainly from vehicle exhaust and power plants. Irritates airways and increases risk of respiratory infections.
pollutants.coDesc: Produced by burning fuel. At high levels, reduces the amount of oxygen your blood can carry.

action.heading: Take Action
action.defaultAction: Call 311 to report idling trucks, strong odors, or visible pollution in your neighborhood.

sms.heading: Get Alerts
sms.body: We'll text you when air quality turns unhealthy in your area — one text, no spam.

sms.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
